HOW TO PLAY
Drag one of the three shapes onto the 8 × 8 grid. You can also tap a shape, then tap the cell for its top-left corner. Pieces keep their orientation: there is no rotation, gravity or time limit. Only the occupied squares of a shape need to fit.

Fill any row or column to clear it, regardless of color. Rows and columns completed together disappear simultaneously. Place all three shapes to receive the next tray. Each new tray has at least one complete sequence of legal placements when dealt; choosing the order and positions still matters.

SCORE & COMBOS
Each placed square earns 5 points. A clear earns 100 × the number of lines squared × the combo. The first clear starts combo ×1; another clear increases it. Two moves without a clear are allowed; a third resets the combo. Emptying the whole grid adds 500 points.

EXPLORE
Classic is an endless score challenge. Adventure offers 36 freely selectable levels: meet every displayed goal, and collect gems by clearing their rows or columns. Daily puzzles use a fixed seed for each date and remain replayable. Relax automatically deals a fresh tray when nothing fits.

FREE SECOND CHANCES
Undo and hints are always free. The last 200 moves are kept, including across app restarts. More → Fresh tray replaces the three shapes and resets the combo, without removing board cells or gems or granting points. Your score stays. Records include games using these tools. No ads, purchases, lives, countdowns or daily streak penalties.

Your progress is saved locally after each move, separately for each mode, level and daily puzzle. Sound, music, animations and touch feedback can be changed in Settings.
